inventory_recipes.preparation_steps: Heat 15g of unsalted butter in a heavy-bottomed pan. Add onion paste and cook until translucent. Add ginger garlic paste and fry until raw aroma dissipates. Pour in tomato puree and Kashmiri red chilli powder, simmering on medium heat until fat separates. Reduce heat, stir in cashew paste and a splash of water, mixing continuously to achieve a smooth gravy base. Fold in fresh paneer cubes and simmer for 3 minutes. Stir in heavy cream and the remaining butter. Garnish with a sprinkle of crushed kasuri methi before serving hot.

Heat oil in a pan, crackle mustard seeds, then add curry leaves, chopped green chillies, and sliced onions. Sauté until soft. Add turmeric powder, salt, and coarsely mashed boiled potatoes. Mix well with a splash of water to form the potato masala filling. Heat a cast iron tawa, pour fermented dosa batter in the center, and spread thinly in a spiral motion. Drizzle desi ghee over the top and edges. Cook on medium-high heat until crisp and golden. Place potato masala in the center, fold, and serve hot.
